audit_scope: Comprehensive audit of nebulacomponents.com as public-facing website and landing page audit service
methodology: Evidence-based observation using manual inspection, API verification, and constrained testing due to environmental limitations

findings.title: Multiple public pages return identical documentation content
findings.observation: When accessing pages such as /about, /pricing, /learning-centre, /blog, /teardowns, and others, the server returns identical documentation content instead of page-specific information.
evidence: Fetching https://nebulacomponents.com/about returns documentation content matching the pattern seen in sitemap.xml and pricing page
Fetching https://nebulacomponents.com/pricing returns identical documentation content
The homepage (https://nebulacomponents.com/) returns distinct, appropriate homepage content
All affected pages return HTTP 200 status with identical content bodies
JSON/API endpoints (/openapi.json, /.well-known/acp.json, /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json) return correct content types
findings.inference: There is likely a routing misconfiguration, CMS issue, or server-side rendering problem where specific page routes are falling back to a default documentation template.
user_business_impact: Prevents users from accessing detailed information about pricing, company background, educational resources, and legal policies
Undermines trust and transparency as users cannot verify service details
Negatively impacts SEO as search engines encounter duplicate content across multiple URLs
Hinders user journey as visitors cannot access expected information at key decision points
Directly impacts conversion funnel by blocking access to pricing, trust-building, and educational content
Contradicts service's own evidence-based transparency principles
findings.remediation: Investigate and fix routing/content delivery system to serve correct content for each URL path
validation_method: Fetch each affected URL and verify content matches expected page type
Check HTTP headers for correct content-type and caching directives
Verify no console errors in browser dev tools when navigating to these pages
Test internal navigation and user flows
